name: Banca IFIS S.p.A.
summary: Banca IFIS S.p.A. provides financial services and solutions for enterprises. The company provides saving and current accounts, time deposits, and insurance; factoring, advisory and equity investment, structured finance, leasing, and medium/long term loans for industrial investments; salary-backed loan technology rental services; financial advisory/M&A; and factoring import/export, import/export loans, and other foreign banking services. It also engages in the purchase and management of non-performing loan portfolios. Banca IFIS S.p.A. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Mestre, Italy.
